historical_test_scope: E99 checkpoint: 448 scoped CPU tests in 20 files; historical revalidation: 1965 unique cases. Different overlapping scopes, neither rerun in this planning revision.
primary_question: Can a new complete authenticated representation preserve the fast native encrypted-search evaluator and compact client reply without repeated trusted index work or relocated dense state? Can a restricted finite adaptive-lifetime bound add a useful, nonheuristic consequence?

contracts.primary_output: All exact stable-ID/Hamming-score pairs, with stable local top-three selection
contracts.data_ownership: Owner/client may retain all plaintext and any summaries; no cache prohibition
contracts.adversary: One malicious compute host/server; adaptive private legal queries; observable accept/abort and declared traffic metadata
contracts.enrollment: Owner-built authenticated index/key/layout/ID epoch first; malicious outsourced enrollment is additional work
contracts.first_checker_mode: Owner-approved protected checker has verification secrets and encrypted/public material, but no HE secret, plaintext index or decrypted-score witness
contracts.checker_compromise: Can permit forged release and a decryption-feedback oracle; no unconditional HE-privacy claim against checker compromise
contracts.implementation: Homemade reference/native/CUDA deliverable; SEAL/author artifacts are pinned controls

screening_targets.note: Project screens, not promised gains or conference acceptance criteria; choose full-cost objective before measurement and retain the Pareto curve. Unknown costs are unknown, not zero.

routes.new_result_required: A shared canonical witness/check representation or restricted algorithm with full-error sensitivity, original-input-to-wire binding and a useful complete resource point beyond equally optimized controls
strongest_controls: Equally optimized generic elimination and geometric/polynomial batching
Full trusted recomputation and attested full evaluator
stop_conditions: Cancelling error or unchecked canonical constraint
Unpriced witness generation, helper work, state or traffic
budget_components: One independent exact/count component before native work
must_check: Full original graph and wire decoder
Original query and all-row stable-ID coverage
routes.E100_role: Unimplemented conditional remainder-first control if a concrete canonicalization bottleneck needs it; elementary rewrite is not the main claim

routes.new_result_required: A restricted finite nonheuristic tail bound for an actual reused-key dependency graph, handling a new case and changing a useful cryptographic resource choice
routes.theorem_target: Unconditional good-setup failure epsilon_epoch plus conditional per-legal-adaptive-query delta_i, giving epsilon_epoch + sum_i delta_i for the stated lifetime; union bound itself is known
method_proposals: Valid conditioning or filtration of still-fresh coins
Exact finite MGFs or certified concentration
Deterministic bounds on fixed source/key residuals
strongest_controls: E97/E99 fixed-input rounding and gadget controls
stop_conditions: Depends on posterior IID or unquantified Gaussian tail
MGF coefficient uses the same fresh randomness without valid conditioning
Finite bound vacuous at useful sizes
Claims smaller Q or sparse security without matching assurance
routes.parameter_note: Correctness bounds, heuristic hardness estimates, and parameter approval are distinct; actual full-N sparse/derived-key transcript remains open

routes.new_result_required: A distinct owner summary/block/coverage representation with useful complete exact-top-three retrieval under declared traffic privacy and permitted caches
routes.known_control: Authenticated owner partition, centroid/radius metric lower bounds, stable-ID lower bounds, candidate PIR and exact local ranking
strongest_controls: PANTHER/SANNS clustering and private candidate retrieval
stop_conditions: Unfetched-row coverage or stable ties missing
Fixed privacy padding erases the gain
AEAD treated as a pre-decryption gate for outer HE
budget_components: One exact/count component before a large service

tasks.deliverable: Current evidence/closest-work revision, nine new primary sources, executable handoff, append-only progress

tasks.acceptance: Complete graph/error/count control and a precise novel candidate difference, or an explicit bounded stop
Finite restricted theorem/dependency control with a useful distinct consequence, or a scoped negative; may run after D1 stops
Separate contract, complete omitted-row coverage, paid traffic privacy and cache frontier, or early stop
R6 chooses one mechanism only after applicable contract/novelty screens; otherwise a documented pivot. No broad gate accepted by planning.
Homemade complete reference for all roles with canonical packets, safe release, durable lifecycle/updates and strong baseline adapter
Matched complete service/lifecycle/resource evaluation, declared parameters and uncertainty; no cross-study multiplied ratios
Actual transcript reduction, full noise/hardness/auxiliary-key/lifecycle analysis and independent review before security claims
Profile-driven homemade native/CUDA path, complete ablations/held-out evaluation, preserved reproducibility artifact and manuscript claims matching evidence

return_policy: After every subcomponent append hypothesis, exact scope, immutable evidence, strongest-control delta, complete costs, pass/stop and next action; return to R6/earliest unmet applicable gate. Do not retry a contained recipe without stating a new distinction.
evaluation_boundaries: Cold owner enrollment, new client, returning client and multiple devices
Every network link and complete proof/witness/attestation packet
Private hints/state, index/evaluation keys, RSS and GPU memory
Allowed plaintext/compressed caches with acquisition/update costs
Query lifetime, updates, invalidation, retries and concurrency
Matched checked-service controls and separately labeled unchecked lower bound
Serial monitored process blocks and measured transport for network claims
preservation: Earlier executed scopes, source/raw identities, company code, main/staging and checkpoint refs unchanged; historical governance hashes validated at their evidence commit rather than overwritten by this plan
